# Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD)

> International framework for biodiversity conservation, sustainable use of biological resources, and benefit-sharing governed by multiple protocols including biosafety regulations.

CBD.int hosts information on the Convention on Biological Diversity and its related protocols, including the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety which regulates genetically modified organisms and transboundary movements. The site serves as a central resource for international biodiversity policy, compliance monitoring, and capacity-building initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Convention on Biological Diversity
- Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety
- Nagoya Protocol
- Global Biodiversity Framework
- Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs)
- Biosafety
- Risk Assessment
- Transboundary Movements
- Capacity Building
- Compliance Monitoring
- Biodiversity Protection
- International Treaty
- Benefit Sharing
- Kuala Lumpur Supplementary Protocol

## Biosafety Protocol

- [The Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety](http://bch.cbd.int/protocol): Overview of Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety and international GMO regulations
